description: Full frontend review in one pass, combining a design/UX dimension driven by the impeccable, ui-ux-pro-max, and frontend-design upstream skills as hard prerequisites with stop-and-install, with auto-detected code dimensions (React performance, TypeScript type safety, PWA architecture, platform compliance) spawned from local plugins declared as hard dependencies, so a dimension is skipped only when its signal does not match. Findings consolidate into a unified scored report at .frontend-review/report.md. Pure orchestration; vendors nothing.
name: frontend-review
